title: Conservative Generic-Time Column Advance Prototype

candidate_design.persistent_state: layer water storage only in the prototype; head is reconstructed from storage
candidate_design.face_flux: MFP-secanted Darcy finite-volume closure with scalar equal-flux solve at heterogeneous material interfaces
candidate_design.time_integration: explicit conservative trial update; reject rather than clip if layer storage leaves constitutive bounds
candidate_design.retry: return admissible-step diagnostic to caller; no committed state mutation
candidate_design.mass_ledger: top-bottom + sources-sinks equals storage change on every accepted trial

qualification_questions: Does the face closure preserve hydrostatic zero flux?
Does homogeneous gravity-only flow reduce to q=K?
Does a heterogeneous interface satisfy equal full flux across both half layers?
Does every accepted column step conserve mass to floating-point precision?
Are rejected trials non-mutating and diagnostically retryable?
Does temporal error decrease under step refinement for smooth nonstationary forcing?
Can per-face work remain bounded independently of column-wide Newton convergence?

hard_holds.WOFOST_max_dry_wet_closure: not admitted as SWAP5 candidate physics
hard_holds.root_uptake_process: represented only as external sink vector
